results: Custom frame: a 32px draggable app row sits above the tab row; the readout itself is not a drag area
Bar colour and the native window buttons follow theme and palette changes; readout contrast ≥4.5 in all 31 palettes
Readout shows CPU %, GPU % and total memory (CPU 0.2%·GPU 0.0%·内存 259 MB) with an explanatory tooltip
Mihomo cores started by the app are added to the memory total (27.1 MB)
Instance page view stays aligned below the extra row
Title-bar mute-all silences running instances, is remembered, and toggles back
CPU reflects real load: one busy core ≈ 5.0% of 16 cores (shown with one decimal under 10%)
No overflow at 1024/1280/1440 and the readout never sits under the window buttons
Refresh pauses while minimized and resumes on restore
